name: Matsuura Anju
source:
Likes: Alcohol, coffee.
Dislikes: Pear.
The erotic language teacher of the school.
She has a voluptuous figure and is stated to have the best proportions in the school. Despite her glamorous appearance, she has a friendly and easy-going personality. She has great pride in her own beauty. She deliberately wear revealing clothes to show off her seductive body, and encourages the lust of the male students watching her.
